create.name: Matthew Fox
create.bio:
Theologian and Episcopal priest Matthew Fox is best known for reviving Creation Spirituality, an earth-honouring mystical tradition that draws on the Western mystics, Indigenous wisdom, the arts and modern science. He was a Dominican for 34 years, and in Paris, at the Institut Catholique, he earned a doctorate in the history and theology of spirituality. The Institute in Culture and Creation Spirituality, which he founded, ran first at Mundelein College in Chicago and then at Holy Names University in Oakland; he went on to found the University of Creation Spirituality and served as its president until 2005.

Original Blessing, Creativity, The Coming of the Cosmic Christ and A Spirituality Named Compassion are among his more than 40 books. He has done much to return mystics such as Meister Eckhart, Hildegard of Bingen, Thomas Aquinas and Julian of Norwich to wider reading. The Four Paths of Creation Spirituality give his teaching its shape: awe, letting go, creativity and transformation. He offers recorded and live online courses, several with the cosmologist Brian Thomas Swimme or the writer Mirabai Starr, and the free Daily Meditations with Matthew Fox are written in his tradition.

books.title: Original Blessing: A Primer in Creation Spirituality
books.author: Matthew Fox
books.description: His best-known book, first published in 1983, sets out Creation Spirituality through four paths and twenty-six themes. It argues that the Christian story begins with blessing rather than sin, and draws on mystics such as Hildegard, Eckhart and Julian.

books.title: The Coming of the Cosmic Christ
books.author: Matthew Fox
books.description: Explores the idea of the Cosmic Christ, the sacred presence in all of creation, as a basis for renewing religion and our relationship with the earth. It brings together mysticism, ecology and modern cosmology.

books.title: Creativity: Where the Divine and the Human Meet
books.author: Matthew Fox
books.description: Treats creativity as a spiritual practice and the place where human and divine meet. It looks at how artistic and everyday creativity can shape work, education and community.

books.title: The Physics of Angels: Exploring the Realm Where Science and Spirit Meet
books.author: Matthew Fox, Rupert Sheldrake
books.description: A dialogue between Matthew Fox and the biologist Rupert Sheldrake on angels. They read the writings of Dionysius, Hildegard and Aquinas alongside ideas from modern science.

books.title: Hildegard of Bingen: A Saint for Our Times
books.author: Matthew Fox
books.description: An introduction to the 12th-century abbess, visionary, composer and writer Hildegard of Bingen. Fox presents her ideas on creation, the Divine Feminine and justice as wisdom for today.

books.title: Meister Eckhart: A Mystic-Warrior for Our Times
books.author: Matthew Fox
books.description: Places the medieval mystic Meister Eckhart in conversation with thinkers and traditions from Buddhism and Taoism to modern psychology and science. It shows how his teaching can inform spiritual life and action now.

books.title: Christian Mystics: 365 Readings and Meditations
books.author: Matthew Fox
books.description: A year of short daily readings from Christian mystics across the centuries, each with a reflection by Fox. It works as a daily devotional and as an introduction to the mystical tradition.

books.title: One River, Many Wells: Wisdom Springing from Global Faiths
books.author: Matthew Fox
books.description: Sets passages from many of the world's faiths side by side on shared themes. Fox calls this approach deep ecumenism: one underground river of wisdom reached through many wells.

books.title: The Hidden Spirituality of Men: Ten Metaphors to Awaken the Sacred Masculine
books.author: Matthew Fox
books.description: Offers ten archetypes and metaphors, from the Green Man to Father Sky, for a healthy and spiritual masculinity. It invites men to reconnect with their inner life and with the natural world.

books.title: The Reinvention of Work: A New Vision of Livelihood for Our Time
books.author: Matthew Fox
books.description: Looks at work as an expression of the soul and as part of the Great Work of the universe. Drawing on mystics and poets, it questions how we earn a living and suggests ways to make work meaningful.

courses.title: The 4 Paths of Creation Spirituality
courses.description: A self-paced course with the cosmologist Brian Thomas Swimme on the four paths of Creation Spirituality: awe, letting go, creativity and transformation. Seven recorded 90-minute modules combine the mystics with the modern story of the universe.

courses.title: 7 Mystics on Recovering the Sacred & Forging a New Story for Humanity
courses.description: A 12-module recorded course on seven creation mystics and what they offer a new story for humanity. Themes include creativity, work, education and the sacred masculine and Divine Feminine.

courses.title: Science, Spirituality & the Noosphere: Hope for Humanity’s Future
courses.description: Seven recorded modules with Brian Thomas Swimme on the noosphere, the idea of a shared planetary mind. The course brings modern science and mystical spirituality together, with practices and exercises.

courses.title: Answer the Call for an Uncommon Life Through the Mystical Teachings of St. Hildegard
courses.description: A seven-module recorded course on Hildegard of Bingen's teaching on creation, the Divine Feminine, ecology and justice. It includes guided meditations, prayer and art-based reflection, with Mirabai Starr as guest teacher.

courses.title: Deepen Into the Mystical Teachings of St. Hildegard
courses.description: A nine-module recorded course that goes further into Hildegard's art, writings and music, and her links to Benedictine and Celtic spirituality. Guest teachers are John Philip Newell and Sister Joan Chittister.

courses.title: Julian of Norwich
courses.description: Seven recorded sessions with Mirabai Starr on the 14th-century mystic Julian of Norwich. Topics include living with uncertainty, the sacred in nature and the motherhood of God.

courses.title: Training for Modern Mystics & Prophets
courses.description: Seven recorded 90-minute sessions drawing on Meister Eckhart, Hildegard of Bingen, Thomas Merton and Mary Oliver. It looks at combining a mystical connection with the Divine with courageous action in the world.

courses.title: Christ Path Seminar
courses.description: A recording of a live seminar with Matthew Fox and Andrew Harvey on Creation Spirituality and sacred activism. It runs to more than ten hours of dialogue and bonus material.

free_resources.title: Daily Meditations with Matthew Fox
free_resources.description: Short daily reflections in the Creation Spirituality tradition, mostly written by Matthew Fox, with a weekly summary. You can read them on the site or subscribe to receive them by email.

flags: Tier does not match reputation: 40+ books (Original Blessing is a long-standing bestseller) but his own social counts are tiny; a human may want to raise him to luminary.
The published email belongs to Dennis Edwards, Executive Director of the Matthew Fox Legacy Project (an sbcglobal.net address), not to Matthew Fox himself.
The Physics of Angels is co-authored with Rupert Sheldrake, who is already a Spiritpedia listing; link both.

Several courses are co-taught with Brian Thomas Swimme (4 Paths, Noosphere) and Mirabai Starr (Julian of Norwich), and Neil Douglas-Klotz's plan cites Fox forewords; check whether those people are or will be listed.
The Noosphere course page shows two prices ($347 / $297); I used $297 USD, which looks like the current price.
His own YouTube channel holds mostly short 4-8 minute clips with low views, so seven of the twelve videos are talks or interviews on other channels where he is the main speaker.
